new_direction: freeze-first + quiescence: (1) writers stop on the frozen paths and FROZEN publishes the pins before reviewers are dispatched; (2) auxiliary gate inputs (KEY_MANIFEST, test fixtures, taxonomy consistency evidence) are part of the freeze and must be pinned too; (3) gate verdicts are invalid if any pinned input changes between the two verdicts - the transient KEY_MANIFEST lag that flipped check_class_schema R22 FAIL->PASS on identical schema bytes is the worked example; (4) created_at must not exceed wall clock.
next_falsifier: a gate verdict issued while a pinned input is changing
old_direction: freeze-first review: one declared sha per target, verdicts count only if the hash is unchanged when the second verdict lands
reason: Measured this lifecycle: five target revisions in eight minutes, a 2-minute window in which the schemas were rev12 but KEY_MANIFEST was stale so the binding gate failed, and every pre-move verdict void at the new pins.
